fixture.label: copied-group profile/comparison fixture, not independent quiet-host Gate A acceptance

rule: Five AB BA AB BA AB fresh-process campaign pairs per comparison; five persistent OS-cold exports per campaign. Primary trial is each campaign median (RSS uses its five-pass maximum). Improvement/regression must exceed the larger full campaign range; never count the 25 correlated passes as 25 independent trials. RSS limit applies to every observed pass.
cpuScope: /proc renderer-process user+system deltas include all threads and ended helper threads. Chrome-tree process IDs stable throughout every pass. Natural GC is included in timed process CPU. Per-thread GC trace unions are a covered-event lower bound. Post-campaign diagnostic forced GC is excluded from timing and sampled peaks; none occurs between five passes.

retention.scope: Five interleaved fresh-renderer campaigns, five OS-cold real exportStream passes each, one fixed post-setup RSS baseline per campaign; copied-group profile fixture, not quiet-host Gate A. Primary trial is the campaign; 25 passes are correlated subobservations per variant.

window32Decision: Rejected: no RSS improvement beyond spread, median campaign peak worse, two of 25 passes over +256 MiB, 31% more platform reads. Production keeps 64 MiB.

byteProof.scope: Retained runtime 646fed2c, five full 1M x 200 streams vs frozen 97192fcd parent; SHA-256 chains every physical native byte and frame metadata, including NULL masks, padding, dictionary deltas. Correctness-only timing/RSS excluded.

limits: No quiet-host absolute 190k rows/s or 5M completion claim. Independent 17-group acceptance fixture not measured here.
Copied data can flatter compression/dictionaries; setup/catalogue/snapshot discovery and client row-object construction are excluded. Real SQL, executor, ResultChannel and owner transfers are timed.
Fresh renderer campaigns each have their own fixed post-setup baseline, not one common absolute baseline across processes.
RSS is sampled at nominal 100 ms with actual per-pass gaps recorded; short peaks may be missed.
Warm direct storage point CPU median is numerically worse within measured spread; this does not establish performance equivalence. SQL point selection uses id + 0 because parent keyLookup is refused.
Non-retained exact source misses refund lease charges and drop private copies on release; they are not pooled. Retained cached hits remain usable.
The extra full-demand window probe passed unchanged; the suspected full-group dense overread was disproved by the existing 2048-row demand clamp. No table-scan.ts edit was made.
